item.content:encoded: Although not my favorite new format introduced into the contest, it is definitely interesting. Besides format, I really liked the idea of a terraforming project, and how Prometheus is attempting to carry it out. The very last paragraph got me, when it started talking about the possibility of a Permian-level extinction event. Overall, very good. Happily upvoted!

item.content:encoded:
This is the first custom "SCP" from Prometheus Labs. It details a proposal to create organisms that can terraform an environment and create organisms adapted to the new environment.

I wish I could spend more time on it, but I've been way too busy over the last couple weeks to devote as much time as I want.

See more of my work on my author page!
